consumer_baseline.baseline_policy: Start a new clean worktree and branch from this remote tip. Do not base the migration on an unpushed research branch, squash history, or rewrite the RC4.5.7 records.

diagnostic_fixture_example.purpose: Evidence that the Provider identity changes for one matrix construction; these digests must not be copied into Control as universal constants.

identity_contract_change.canonical_consumer_rule: Recompute the Periodic provider identity and canonical SHA-256 from each existing PSSolver-Control canonical fixture against Provider 674a812. Prove that the only semantic difference from its matching rc4 identity is the named Hermitian projection path. Bind any expected digest to that exact fixture and full canonical metadata, never to the diagnostic digest above.

channel.required_result: The matching canonical Channel fixture must remain byte-identical in metadata and digest.

consumer_work_order.action: Create a clean rc5 migration worktree and branch from origin/migration/pssolver-v0.2.0rc4-rc457-tf32-identity at 0e3895d664d1b81925127848b2dfde638f39763d; verify the ancestry includes qualified source b8539e0ec4c137a6c13746f6832e26e74be24515.

Use only Provider source 674a8121779be72c95aa5dc9e2babca0ce7b93a9 and the qualified rc5 wheel SHA-256 3097b08b08ba7b2d488fd8af348ec48986d69007a640bd806a225ec9963bb65f. Verify the two Provider records and external manifests registered above before changing Consumer files.

Recompute identities with the existing canonical Periodic and Channel fixture builders. Persist full rc4/rc5 canonical metadata, a structural diff, and canonical SHA-256 values. Require the Periodic diff to contain exactly the Hermitian projection path and require Channel to remain identical.

Update only forward-looking Consumer identity expectations, compatibility records, and their tests. Do not rewrite RC4.5.7 historical migration or closure records. Change adapter/runtime code only if a failing public-contract test proves it necessary, and report such a need before making that broader change.

Add fail-closed coverage: the old Periodic expected identity must reject rc5 before mutation or timestep; the newly computed fixture-specific identity must accept rc5; the Channel identity must continue to accept; unrestricted construction must remain possible when no expected identity is supplied.

Run targeted source tests and the complete Consumer CPU suite against the clean Provider source. Do not add skips, xfails, threshold relaxations, or environment-dependent normalization. Record every skip identity.

Build Provider and Consumer wheels from clean archives, install both with --no-deps in a fresh environment, run pip check, prove imports come only from site-packages, and rerun the targeted and complete installed-wheel CPU gates.

Commit the source migration and CPU qualification locally as separable commits, leave the worktree clean, and stop. Do not push, submit H100, tag, release, publish, merge, or modify PSSolver/nematics3d without new authorization.
